response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, long-tenured full-stack/systems engineer with strong craftsmanship and language breadth (C, C++, C#, Java, TypeScript), meeting the baseline experience requirement, but his resume shows no evidence of experimentation platforms, feature flagging, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, A/B testing, or growth engineering — the core focus of this Principal-level role. There is also no demonstrated large-scale cross-team technical leadership or IC6-caliber systemic influence comparable to what's expected here.
strengths: Broad, multi-language engineering background (C, C++, C#, Java, TypeScript) spanning web, embedded, and distributed systems
Long track record (15+ years) with diverse high-scale systems (Sociomantic handling millions of requests/sec)
Demonstrated mentorship, workshop creation, and knowledge-sharing initiative
concerns: No visible experience with experimentation frameworks, feature flagging, or rollout/guardrail systems
No evidence of telemetry/metrics platform work or statistical/experimental analysis
Career trajectory shows 'Senior/Staff' titles rather than principal-level cross-org technical leadership akin to IC6 scope

key_factors.factor: Strong general engineering breadth and seniority
